newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks open higher, techs strong.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks open higher, techs strong.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened broadly higher on Wednesday, with semiconductor shares driving the Nasdaq Composite to solid gains.
The Dow industrials was up four to 5,971 in early trade. The NASDAQ Index rose nine to 1,249, while the S&P Index was up one at 702.
The long bond was up 15/32 to yield 6.77 percent.
